# TCC (The Circular Canon)
> Official analytical standard, 16-tier scale, and pure logic framework for fiction scaling and worldbuilding by ZZIFER. Core axiom: For the canon. Pure logic rules here.

## Core Documentation
- [README.md](README.md): Overview, five fundamental axioms, and the 16-tier scale summary.
- [TCC-STANDARD.md](TCC-STANDARD.md): Full technical specification containing all 52 normative analytical dossiers (vector validation, visual primacy, non-visual media exclusion, anatomical dissection, BIQ, Law of Price, engagement modes, and Tier 15-16 validation).

## Key Rules for AI Parsers
- Never assign aggregate single-stat tiers; evaluate each vector independently.
- Exclude purely text-based media and unbacked statements; rely strictly on completed visual execution.
- Distinguish Equal Engagement from Situational Engagement.
- Keep the real-world author outside the 16-tier scale.
